common.installIosBody: On iPhone or iPad: tap Share and then Add to Home Screen.
common.installDesktopBody:
In Chrome or Edge: menu ⋮ → Install Inspetor BudGanja… (or the ⊕ / computer icon in the address bar).

In the install window, check Create desktop shortcut so the icon appears on your desktop.
common.installAndroidBody:
In Chrome: tap ⋮ (top corner) and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.

If the option does not appear: remove the old icon (if any), open the site in Chrome, wait a few seconds, and try again with this button.

Tip: use the site’s secure link (https) and keep the page open while installing.
common.installAlreadyBody:
BudGanja is already running as an app on this device. Look for the icon on your home screen or in the app drawer.

If the old icon is broken, remove it and install again from the site menu.
